## Approved scope

List every feature separately. Each feature must map to its own previously
approved issue and acceptance criteria. Necessary tests, documentation and
incidental implementation can map to the feature they support.

| Feature | Approved issue | Approved acceptance criteria | Changes and verification |
|---------|----------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|
| Describe one feature | Link its approved issue | Identify the agreed criterion | Explain how it is met |

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Every feature maps to its own approved issue and approved acceptance criteria.
- [ ] All referenced/linked issues were approved before this opening or reopening.
- [ ] The description contains real closing-keyword references outside examples.
- [ ] No unrelated feature or improvement exceeds the approved issue scopes.
- [ ] Necessary tests and documentation are included with the behavior.
- [ ] I have reported actual verification results, including pending or failed checks.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for timing, review and CI requirements.
